description: This file defines the DiskBuilder class, which provides an interface for constructing and managing disk images, partitions, and related configurations within the Cuttlefish project. It includes methods for setting disk paths, partitions, VM configurations, and building disk images if necessary.

classes.name: DiskBuilder
classes.description: A class that facilitates building and configuring disk images, including setting disk paths, partitions, VM modes, and performing build operations.

methods.name: EntireDisk
methods.description: Sets the path for the entire disk image.

methods.name: Partitions
methods.description: Sets the list of image partitions for the disk.

methods.name: HeaderPath
methods.description: Sets the header file path for the disk image.

methods.name: FooterPath
methods.description: Sets the footer file path for the disk image.

methods.name: CrosvmPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the Crosvm executable.

methods.name: CompositeDiskPath
methods.description: Sets the path for the composite disk.

methods.name: ResumeIfPossible
methods.description: Sets whether to resume if possible.

methods.name: WillRebuildCompositeDisk
methods.description: Checks if the composite disk needs to be rebuilt.

methods.name: BuildCompositeDiskIfNecessary
methods.description: Builds the composite disk if necessary, returning whether it was rebuilt.

methods.name: BuildOverlayIfNecessary
methods.description: Builds the overlay if necessary, returning whether it was rebuilt.

methods.name: TextConfig
methods.description: Generates a text configuration for the disk builder.
